footprints.rule: when the player (or a following creature) leaves a cell whose ground tile name starts with one of these prefixes, spawn the matching footprint decal; decals fade (3 frames x 1333 ms) and are removed after ~4 s; at most 24 alive; not while biking (bike leaves none)

extra_tiles: ids 5001-5677 (x_ names) come from the biome worker kit tileset_extra.json; sheets x_<category> -> tiles_extra/<k>x/. Entries with alias_of are pixel-identical copies of a base tile: maps use the base id (merge remaps them).
